name: Mimasaka Shousuke
source:
The son of a distinguished family that owns Miyoshi Group, a company at the head of a large conglomerate.
His older brother is the successor, but Shousuke is also promised a carefree, comfortable future. From kindergarten onwards he attended prestigious private schools, but for a change of pace he went to a top-tier national university.
He is blessed with good looks and a brilliant mind, and is extremely wealthy, but he has a twisted personality and takes pleasure in tricking and trapping others through careful planning and deception.
His hobby is Japanese painting, and he has visited Mizuki's solo exhibitions several times. He had seen Kazuki there on those occasions.

[Translated from [url=https://pilslash.jp/product/pigeon/]Official site[/url] and [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/PigeonBlood]Wikipedia[/url]]
